entries.heading: RULE OF CONSTRUCTION ON THE PERMANENT STATIONING OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES IN SOMALIA
ancestors: TITLE XII—MATTERS RELATING TO FOREIGN NATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 1271. RULE OF CONSTRUCTION ON 
                          THE PERMANENT STATIONING OF UNITED 
                          STATES ARMED FORCES IN SOMALIA.

    Nothing in this Act may be construed to authorize the permanent 
stationing of members of the Armed Forces in Somalia.
